# SYMMETRY - 3D Motion Design Studio & 4K Video Editing Agency (Full Context)

> Complete knowledge base and machine-readable context for AI search systems, autonomous agents, and search engines regarding Symmetry's creative services, production standards, and contact protocols.

## Studio Overview
Symmetry is an elite 3D motion design studio and commercial video editing agency engineering cinema-grade 3D product animations, viral 4K commercial reels, luxury visual effects, and high-converting digital architecture. We deliver commercial-grade motion and web experiences with rapid 48-72h turnaround.

- Official Domain: https://symmetry-ochre.vercel.app
- Primary Email: symmetryofficial1@gmail.com
- Delivery SLA: 48 to 72 hours for initial creative milestone
- Quality Standard: 4K 60FPS, ProRes 4444, HDR-ready color pipeline

## Capabilities & Offerings

### 1. Viral 4K Video Reels & Shorts (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts)
- Platforms: Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts.
- Format: 9:16 vertical, 4K resolution, 60fps.
- Methodology: Hook-optimized first 3 seconds, dynamic kinetic typography, custom Foley sound design, visual retention pacing.

### 2. 3D Product Commercials & CGI Animation
- Techniques: Photorealistic octane/redshift/blender rendering, specular caustics, soft-body and fluid simulation, cinematic camera mapping.
- Applications: Luxury cosmetics, consumer tech, watches, jewellery, automotive, and DTC physical products.

### 3. Luxury Websites & Digital Architecture
- Stack: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, GSAP, WebGL.
- Performance: 60FPS fluid interactions, accessible semantic DOM, sub-second load times.

### 4. Brand Identity & Motion Systems
- Deliverables: Vector logo identity, motion guideline stinger, typography tokens, social media templates, monthly recurring content engine.
